Progressive Office viewer for the browser

Why it is fast

  • •Lazy ZIP: only the central directory is read up front 

    • –Entries are inflated on demand with DecompressionStream 

  • •Streaming XML parser in a Web Worker 

    • –Blocks / rows / slides arrive progressively 

  • •Virtualized React views
